# Plan Friday: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-07 · code e096891e8e49 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Plan a last-minute weekend dinner party on Friday: send one link, guests pick the day and say what they're bringing, and you lock in the best day. No guest accounts.
**Live:** https://planfriday.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/planfriday · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/planfriday/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py planfriday` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Converted to native Forms on branch `forms` (2026-11-07)** from the JS-template app (old source folder `planfriday`,
  web/pages/*.html). Same server code, db_schema and #addresses (`#p/<token>` is the link hosts send). The guide
  above still describes the old JS layout until the branch is merged (CONVERT step 5).
- **JavaScript stays only for drawing**: `theme/assets/pf.js` = the 13 party pictures (ART, inline SVG in the three inks),
  the weather icons, clipboard, file download (.ics), share sheet, confetti. Python reaches it only through
  `client_code/pf.py`; pictures are drawn by `Components/Art` (cover or wx) and `Components/WxChip`.
- **pf.py holds the data that was window.PF**: IDEAS (the catalogue), TAGS, STYLES, PARTS/DAY_PARTS, DIETS, DISH_TAGS,
  SUGGEST (dice ideas), NUT_WORDS (a JS regex run by `PF.test`: keep in step with Guests.py NUT_WORDS), date helpers
  (browser-local days, English names), weather words/advice. tools/testing/test_server.py reads SUGGEST from pf.py.
- **Browser storage keeps the old keys** (`planfriday.<key>` in localStorage): guest secret `g.<token>`, `visited`,
  `name`, `town`, `units`, `justMade`, `theme`. pf.py reads them with json.loads (UI.store returns JS proxies).
- **Party page** (`Pages/Party`): every guest action / host tool returns the whole view and `_took()` redraws;
  `_call` = guest actions (token + secret first), `_host` = host tools (party id). A 30 s `window.setInterval` quiet
  refresh starts on show and stops on hide; it skips while a dialog is open or a text field has focus (pf.js
  dialogOpen/typingIn). New parties: Plan stores `justMade`, Party throws confetti and selects the link box.
- **CSS**: app.css = old core.css tokens + the template's design kit/core + the catalogue skin + old page CSS with
  selectors widened to Anvil Buttons (`:is(.ui-btn.x, .anvil-role-btn.anvil-role-btn-x > button, ...)`), then the
  "Plan Friday as Forms" block at the end (item hosts with `display: contents`, RepeatingPanel grids on
  `.anvil-role-<x> > div`, seg/step/link-btn/ans/rsvp roles). The weather box icon class is `pt-wx-ic` (not `.ic`:
  that is the icon-mask class).
- **Tests**: `tools/ui/smoke.js` opens every address signed out, as a new member (who orders Taco Saturday so their own
  #p, #sheet and #edit open too) and as admin (arkulinskis@gmail.com is in ADMIN_EMAILS; fixed test password, local
  Docker DB only). Locally the weather says "opens two weeks ahead": the App Server container has no internet.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
